title: Maharashtra Fees Regulating Authority Gets Tax Exemption Under Section 10(46) (CBDT Notification No. 98/2026)
content:
# Maharashtra Fees Regulating Authority Gets Tax Exemption Under Section 10(46) (CBDT Notification No. 98/2026)

Ek important update hai! The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Maharashtra Fees Regulating Authority ko Income-tax Act, 1961 ke Section 10(46) ke under tax exemption benefits provide kiye hain. Yeh notification 27th July, 2026 ko jari kiya gaya hai.

**Key points:**

*   **Notification Details:** This exemption has been granted via Notification No. 98/2026-Income Tax, dated July 27, 2026.
*   **Beneficiary:** The tax exemption applies to the Fees Regulating Authority, jo ki Government of Maharashtra dwara constitute ki gayi hai.
*   **Exempted Income:** Specified income streams ko tax se exempt kiya gaya hai. Ismein shamil hain processing fees, interest, penalties, aur private professional educational institutions se milne wale anya charges. Additionally, Government of Maharashtra se milne wale reimbursements ya grants aur bank deposits & other investments se hone wali interest income bhi exempt hogi.
*   **Applicable Sections:** Exemption Section 10(46) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 ke तहत di gayi hai, aur ismein Income-tax Act, 2025 ke Section 536(2)(a), (b), (c) aur (e) ke provisions bhi consider kiye gaye hain.
*   **Conditions:** Yeh exemption kuch conditions par depend karti hai. Authority ko koi commercial activity engage nahi karni hogi, uski activities aur specified income ka nature financial years mein unchanged rehna chahiye, aur use Income-tax Act, 1961 ke Section 139(4C)(g) ke accordance mein apna return of income file karna hoga.
*   **Retrospective Effect:** Yeh notification Assessment Years 2022-23 se 2026-27 (relevant Financial Years 2021-22 se 2025-26) ke liye retrospectively apply hoga.
